annotation_notes: Insert a 2-day Security review at index 3, between Solution design (T3) and Prototype build (T4): predecessor T3, start = T3 finish 2025-04-16, finish 04-18 (calendar days). Sequential application: the later tasks sit at indices 4-8; Prototype build relinks its predecessor to the new task and the chain shifts +2 days (04-18->04-23, ->04-26, ->05-02, ->05-06, ->05-08). summary.taskCount 8->9, projectEnd 05-06->05-08. | REVIEW EDIT (with author): the task id scheme is NOT fixed by the edit, so two outputs are equally correct: (a) keep existing ids stable and give the new task the next free id, or (b) positional RENUMBER (new task takes the slot id, later tasks shift up). Scoring accepts both without rewarding broken links: the new task /id is the sentinel "<any>" (any value accepted); the 5 tail ids /tasks/4..8/id are optional+any (free labels); /tasks/4/predecessorId is a REQUIRED ref_equal to the new task id (/tasks/3/id); the 4 tail predecessorIds /tasks/5..8/predecessorId are optional+ref_equal to the previous task id (if renumbered they must still point at the correct predecessor, but changing them is not required). Stable-id and renumber outputs both score fully; a wrong relink still fails ref_equal; dates independently verify the structure. The same treatment is needed for other structural cases where positional renumber is possible (e.g. task removal).
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a task list where each task has a stated duration and starts when its predecessor finishes, so finishes derive along the precedence chain, rolling up to a task count and a project end. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a project plan would carry that do not depend on the schedule dates, and vary their number and the number of tasks from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Insert one new task with a specific duration at a specific point in the precedence chain.
cascade_pattern: Inserting a task shifts every downstream task later by the inserted duration, raises the task count by one, and moves the project end. Tasks before the insertion point stay. This is determined because durations and links are stated.
